title: Amazon plans to start selling cars online in the UK in early 2027, expanding beyond the US, where it offers new and used cars from 35 brands in 150+ cities (Jamie Nimmo/Bloomberg)
summary: Jamie Nimmo / Bloomberg: Amazon plans to start selling cars online in the UK in early 2027, expanding beyond the US, where it offers new and used cars from 35 brands in 150+ cities — Amazon.com Inc. will soon offer cars on its platform in the UK, joining an increasingly crowded British auto market where Chinese brands are winning over consumers.
